name: White Stallion Exchange
summary: The White Stallion Exchange is an arrangement offered by horse breeder Katie Hunter at Eastvale Logging Camp. Riders who acquired a traditional white stallion can trade their bridle for a steed from the camp's newly outfitted swift herd. It offers Alliance equestrians a fresh look while retaining the speed of their seasoned mount.

sections.title: A New Look at Eastvale
sections.body: Eastvale Logging Camp is known primarily for lumber, but the open pastures along the edge of the forest make it a natural home for Stormwind's horse breeders. Katie Hunter oversees the stables here, tending to both sturdy workhorses and swift riding stock. For riders who already own a prized white stallion, she offers an open trade: surrender your old bridle in exchange for one of her newly bred and armored steeds, granting the mount an updated appearance while maintaining its proven speed.

sections.title: Horses of the Alliance
sections.body: Horses are the traditional backbone of Stormwind's cavalry and civilian travel. As stable masters refine bloodlines and equip steeds with modern barding, riders are given opportunities to adopt mounts from the latest herds. Rather than forcing veteran cavaliers to purchase a replacement outright, stable keepers like Katie allow a straight exchange for those looking to field the freshest breeds.

faq.q: What is the White Stallion Exchange?
faq.answer: It is an exchange offered by Katie Hunter in Elwynn Forest that allows owners of a standard white stallion to trade their mount's bridle for a newly bred swift steed with updated tack and appearance.

faq.q: Where does this exchange take place?
aliases: where to turn in white stallion exchange
faq.answer: The exchange takes place at Eastvale Logging Camp, situated in the eastern reaches of Elwynn Forest near the border of Redridge Mountains.
Katie Hunter, an Alliance horse breeder stationed at the stables in Eastvale Logging Camp, handles the trade.

faq.q: Will the new horse be slower than the old one?
faq.answer: No. Katie Hunter guarantees that the steed from the new herd matches the speed of the original mount, offering only a cosmetic change to its armor and look.

faq.q: Can Horde players trade horses with Katie Hunter?
aliases: can horde do white stallion exchange
faq.answer: No. Katie Hunter is loyal to the Kingdom of Stormwind and will only trade horses with members of the Alliance.

Stable masters across Azeroth introduced refreshed breeds with modern armor and barding, and this trade ensures existing riders can update their mount to the new look without having to buy another horse.

angles.text: Stormwind's equestrian traditions run deep, and the stables at Eastvale allow human riders to ride into battle atop the kingdom's newest stock.
The sturdy steeds of Elwynn provide reliable transportation for Alliance champions navigating the contested roads of the eastern kingdoms.
